scope: Read the five legacy overlay changes, two new modules, twelve prepared tests, protocol, materializer and static default/flat mapping proofs; checked all seventeen handoff file hashes. No candidate module was imported or executed.

resolved_finding.cause: The typed resolver accepted False while legacy normalization rewrote it to class_weight_power=0 and subsequently rejected the same recipe. Direct worker validation instead accepted it with fixed sample weighting.
resolved_finding.R2_resolution: Both True and False class_weights aliases are now rejected before filtering/direct execution. The only supported weighting is the fixed fitting-derived class_weight_power=.5. Existing negative normalization subcases include False; the twelve-method count is unchanged. R1 is preserved.

source_contracts: Known string IDs, engine, fixed values and unsupported parameters are validated before normalization filtering, process-boundary execution and worker IO. Effective parameters/signatures retain the representation ID.

The absent-profile path preserves the existing linear adapter dispatch and result schema. Ordinary CAPABILITIES remain unchanged; the separate internal catalog is not planner enrollment. Legacy default branches and the supplied five-module AST projection agree.

Feature type inference, median imputation, scaling, OHE vocabulary/frequency grouping and sample weights use fitting rows only. Validation/test data are transformed with fitted state; split row IDs must be bounded, unique and disjoint.

Both new profiles share the bounded preparation and fixed Ridge10 or LogisticC1 heads. The sole matched contrast is identity versus seeded RBF128 with gamma=1/actual prepared fitting width. Comparison with the richer strong boosting control is a complete recipe comparison.

Rows, raw columns, numeric/category-code matrices, worst CSR, encoded width and RBF output/projection bounds are checked before processor fitting. Actual matrices are checked for bytes/finiteness afterward; inference uses fixed batches and probability-output allocation checks.

Classification fitting classes must match canonical classes; weights derive from fitting labels, native class_weight is not added, and probabilities are reordered from estimator classes to canonical classes before labels, metrics and requested output mapping.

Every inner/full fit constructs fresh preprocessing, mapper and head. The full worker writes CSV in sample order; validation predictions retain positional split order and original-scale RMSE. Heldout labels only enter evaluation.
The existing flat compiler discovers both new modules. The supplied static proof binds seventy members: five changed, two new, sixty-three unchanged. Runtime flat imports remain a future gate.

tests_source_review.meaningful_cases: Typed rejection before filtering/IO, memory admission before fit, missing classes/invalid targets/target-ID exclusion, matched preprocessing, heldout poison invariance, unknown categories/all-missing numerics/batches, canonical and binary probabilities/weights, positional RMSE/full refit CSV and legacy dispatch.

limitations: 128000000 bytes is a cap per logical matrix, not total live memory or a measured RSS guarantee. Raw frames, simultaneous copies and solver workspaces require the future external time/RSS guard.
fitting_state_sha256 fingerprints preprocessing/mapper state, not full X/y/weights or fitted-head identity; it is not sufficient authority for cache reuse.

A bounded targeted KERN00 run can certify only its tiny technical contracts. The full prospective483 source checks, unpacked/default/flat tests, actual resource cleanup and real artifact validation are not established by this source review.
No public ML gain, measured speed, planner integration, full-agent qualification, promotion or launch readiness is claimed.
